card.name: Past-tense verbs hinting at earlier time
card.fires_on: Verbs and adverbs in the past tense (was, resulted, recognised, under way) in narrative or report text, where the sentence sets up a contrast with the present or an earlier state of affairs.

modes.label: Past 'was' after now/but
modes.description: The word 'was' or a past-state word in a sentence that contrasts earlier and current situations.
modes.example: But now he<< was>> on the move.

modes.label: Past outcome verbs
modes.description: A past-tense verb like 'resulted' describing what happened earlier in a clinical or research statement.
modes.example: discontinuation of filgrastim therapy usually<< resulted>> in a 50% decrease in

modes.label: Dated-info statements
modes.description: Words saying something was true at an earlier time, such as 'current' in an outdated notice.
modes.example: It was<< current>> when produced and may now be outdated.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning earlier or previously (ранее, previously, originally, formerly) and suppresses 'now'.
card.plain: It fires on past-tense wording and makes the model expect words like 'previously' or 'formerly'.
